yanked_versions.0.1.0: Broken by design: this module wraps toolchains_llvm's `llvm` extension, which fails with "Only the root module can use the 'llvm' extension" — so a bazel_dep on it can never produce @llvm_toolchain. Declare the toolchain INLINE in your own root MODULE.bazel instead: bazel_dep(toolchains_llvm 1.8.0) + llvm.toolchain(llvm_version='20.1.3') + register_toolchains('@llvm_toolchain//:all'), plus --repo_env=BAZEL_DO_NOT_DETECT_CPP_TOOLCHAIN=1 in your .bazelrc (a repo_env cannot ride a dependency either). See infra/control-plane and aion/deploy.
